summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtins feature. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with the eleven members from the spec, each with a meaning/type comment. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept an absent endpoint_config (treated as no variant tags); added public compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults at the end of ClientArgsCreator, which reads FIPS/DualStack only via the bridge lookups, reuses the S3 and STS predicates, and returns a dict keyed by enum members. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (26 tests, one per behavioral criterion, S3 predicate mocked with exactly one call asserted). Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 60 passed. Full tests/unit: 11 failures, identical to the unmodified tree (test_awsrequest.py, test_session.py, test_session_legacy.py), so pre-existing. Added lines are within 79 columns; black/isort/flake8 are not in the shared venv, so formatting was done by hand and not tool-verified. Nothing committed; the three files are modified in the working tree.
